manual_checks.derivation: With E1 M,a,rt,R,tau,C fixed first, epsilon->0+ gives D=2*max(r,s); split E2 at s=r for Newtonian enclosed-mass plus exterior-shell potential and PhiPrime=G*m_T/r^2.
manual_checks.assumptions: Finite compact bounded E1 density; no quadrature evaluated; C stays >1 and independent of epsilon.

manual_checks.derivation: Dehnen v1 p9 Eq30 uses rhoP=3Ma^2/(4pi(r^2+a^2)^(5/2)), Phi=-GM/sqrt(r^2+a^2); manual derivative gives acceleration=-GM*x/(r^2+a^2)^(3/2).
manual_checks.assumptions: Separate tau=1,R=infinity,C=1 Newtonian model, not epsilon-only limit of finite E1; no Plummer DF normalization adopted.
Fixed-mass collisionless catalog; closed isolated GP2 additionally gives P constant and free COM. Does not supply gas surface terms.

manual_checks.derivation: Klab=Kint+P^2/(2M), so 2Klab+W=(2Kint+W)+P^2/M. For boost b: P'=P+Mb,Klab'=Klab+b.P+M*b^2/2,H'=H+b.P+M*b^2/2; Kint/W invariant; boosted raw-minus-internal numerator=P'^2/M.
manual_checks.assumptions: Exact algebra; diagnostic Kint implemented later via direct deviations, not cancellation. No boost probe or production finite-precision claim.
